meaning:
(Hiphil) to take the right hand, to turn right, choose to the right, go to the right, use the right hand
Another spelling of ya.man (יָמַן "to go right" H3231)
glosses: you will go to the right

renderings.kjv: when ye turn to the right hand

elsewhere.note: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”
